decisions.reason: The contract requires the system to transition between the named operating states, including Braking. issues.observed: The exact closed Operate-to-Off carrier transition:line:23 has an empty trigger set; keyOff is attached only to child completion transitions.

The closed model has the exact Operate-to-Off carrier at transition:line:23, but its trigger set is empty; keyOff appears only on the child-to-completion transitions. issues.strongest_rebuttal: The reachable child keyOff transitions may semantically route to the same owner-level completion behavior, but the supplied source explicitly places keyOff on the Operate-to-Off relation and the closed carrier itself has no trigger.
